title: Did Mall world get clean bathrooms or am I tripping?
content: This dream started off during class changes like always. It was a couple months into the year and I still couldn’t remember who I had or where my classes were, so I was walking around my old highschool trying to find them, I was going around on my phone trying to remember the name of the application that showed us the names of our teachers and never could remember, (there were vending machines in some hallways and racks with Chips and drinks that looked like they were from a dollar general, in the school cafeteria you could get both normal school food, fast food from a vending machine and fast food from what looks like a food court, everything is just slightly more expensive than it would be outside). Anyways I decided to go to the bathroom and when I went in it was all clean, but only one of the free stalls had a door - and for some reason I just knew that there’d recently been renovations. I took the stall with the door obviously, and in it there’s this really weird toilet right over a bathtub that you can sort of put your feet up on, and there was a showerhead too low down to be useful for an actual shower. I finish pissing, I’m on my phone trying to find that app again and there’s this guy that’s getting really pissed I’m taking so long and says he’s going to break the door down if I don’t hurry up( I’m a girl, this is a mixed gender bathroom even though there are others in the school that are separated between male and female), so I get up and start buttoning my pants. The door swings open, I finish buttoning them, he shoves past me and I go about walking around the halls again trying to find my classrooms. The bell rings. I am now late, and these prison grate things start to be closed at the end of the hallway. In my head I somehow know it is so that students can’t skip; but there are for some reason teenagers closing these grates with a teacher supervising. I yell at them to wait up and they listen, so I get outside of it before they close it. I tell the teacher I’m having trouble finding my classrooms, we have a short conversation I can’t remember where I say something snarky to her and then snap out of it and go “wait , this is a dream.” She gets PISSED. Then suddenly I’m in this prison cell with a bunch of other people in the sky, above a city that somehow manages to look both medieval and modern, and an ocean. There are random trinkets everywhere, some that could help you to be more comfortable and some that make absolutely no sense. A woman that looks like my mother comes to visit, but I know she is not my mother. I scream at her to fuck off. She leaves. I don’t quite feel like it’s been ten years, but it does feel like a very long dream when I scream and cry at one of the guards “it’s been ten years and no one will tell me why I’m here, please just tell me why” or something along those lines. The dream ends then and I wake up when I float out of the cells. —— This is the most detailed dream I’ve ever had and it freaked me tf out.
